capabilities

Show combined help and schema data in one discovery payload.

Usage:
  agent-issues capabilities
  agent-issues capabilities --json

Options:
  --db <path> | Use a specific SQLite database path.
  --json | Print machine-readable JSON. Entity mutations return acknowledgements; list and relation reads return summaries.
  --pretty | Pretty-print JSON when used with --json.
  --help, -h | Show help for the whole CLI or the selected command.

Examples:
  agent-issues capabilities
  agent-issues capabilities --json

Notes:
  Use this command when an agent wants the command catalog and workflow schema in one round trip.

Output:
  Human-readable:
    General help text followed by the workflow schema summary
  JSON fields:
    help
    schema
